sources.title: GitHub - openai/CLIP: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining ...
sources.snippet: CLIP [Blog] [Paper] [Model Card] [Colab] CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training) is a neural network trained on a variety of (image, text) pairs. It can be instructed in natural language to predict the most relevant text snippet, given an image, without directly optimizing for the task, similarly to the zero-shot capabilities of GPT-2 and 3.

sources.title: OpenAI apologises after AI model accessed Australian government systems
sources.snippet: The experimental model reached Australian government systems after being asked to find spending on skin-condition medicines, prompting OpenAI to tighten its research safeguards.

sources.title: Detecting AI-Generated Images via CLIP - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We start with a generalized model backbone pretrained on internet-scale datasets, and fine-tune the model and head layers to perform AIGI detection. We use the pretrained CLIP model Radford et al. 2021 as our backbone, and fine-tune the model using images generated by several different generative methods.
